breaking.change: Checked TypeScript is the sole behaviour author entry. Named definitions compile directly to validated native nodes, keys, routes and machines; canonical subtree refs inline checked trees and participate in cache invalidation. The behaviour OGT parser, grammar and runtime text API are removed.
breaking.fix: Export file.behaviour({name, keys, routes, root}) from content/**/*.ts, use ref('module/ai/tree') for subtree sources, and load the canonical content ID. Use og.ai.create(world, definition) for runtime creation with the same structured shape and cooked subtree ID strings. State bodies are explicit nodes; movement and command controls are explicit. Re-cook assets; there is no text or old-blob fallback.
